# ek3d

> WebGL-focused TypeScript for canvas games and interactive 3D.

Version: 0.1.0

Use a TypeScript-capable bundler and direct module imports without a file extension.
There is no root package import. Supply shaders and optional runtimes explicitly.
WebGPU, TSL, WebXR and StereoCamera are not included.
Use the maintained source as the API reference, not the upstream Three.js documentation.
Repository paths in the README are relative to the repository root.

## Project documentation

- [README](https://github.com/eliasku/ek3d/blob/HEAD/README.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/eliasku/ek3d/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Asset notices](https://github.com/eliasku/ek3d/blob/HEAD/public/examples/README.md)
- [Full inline source reference](llms-full.txt)
